errors.evidence: Description states values as approximately 82.5%, 83%, 83.5%, and 84%, while the figure shows approximately 83.1%, 83.4%, 83.7%, and 83.5%.
The machine-generated description does not mention the purpose of the chart, which is to show MR values against different parameter amounts.
The description fails to note the color of the bars (light blue) and that it is a horizontal bar chart.
The description does not specify the units of the Y-axis as 'M' properly, even though it does mention that the unit is M.
